title: The Vivaldi Way Stick-Blender Anchovy Caesar Dressing
originalTitle: The Vivaldi Way Stick-Blender Anchovy Caesar Dressing
instructions: Prep & mise en place: Gather and prepare all components for The Vivaldi Way Stick-Blender Anchovy Caesar Dressing.
Place all ingredients into a large measuring cup and emulsify with a stick blender
Season to taste with kosher salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and finishing garnishes before serving warm.
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Ingredients: — 1 cup avocado oil — 3 egg yolks — 2 tsp Dijon mustard — 2 cloves of garlic — 3 tbsp lemon juice — 1 tbsp red wine vinegar — 2 tsp Worcestershire — 1/2 tsp Tabasco — 1/4 tsp salt — 1 tbsp rinsed capers — 4-6 Anchovies — 1 tbsp chopped Italian parsley — Instructions: — 1. Place all ingredients into a large measuring cup and emulsify with a stick blender
